children: The Malaysian plantation sector's 3Q earnings are expected to improve sequentially, supported by a seasonal production recovery and broadly stable palm product prices, says Hong Leong IB analyst Chye Wen Fei in a note. Higher output and prices are also expected to support upstream earnings, partly offset by higher fertilizer costs and continued pressure on refining margins, she says. Tighter palm oil supplies, stronger Indonesian biodiesel demand and potential El Nino-related production losses could support prices into 2027. Hong Leong maintains an overweight rating on Malaysia's plantation sector, and pegs Hap Seng Plantations and IOI Corp. as its top picks. (yingxian.wong@wsj.com)
